title: Fix Version 7 go-live failure and run a clean rebuild

requirements.text: Identify and fix the root cause(s) of the Version 7 production go-live (publish) failure by performing a full frontend + backend build pass and resolving any compile/build/runtime-blocking errors with minimal, stability-focused changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister builds successfully (Motoko compilation completes with no errors).
Frontend builds successfully (TypeScript + bundler build completes with no errors).
App can start and render the root route (/) and login route (/login) without runtime exceptions in the console.
A new draft can be generated and the publish/go-live step completes successfully without deployment errors.

requirements.text: Audit routing/guard/redirect logic to ensure no navigation occurs during render and that redirects are handled in effects (or equivalent safe patterns) to prevent runtime crashes during deployment/first load.
acceptanceCriteria: No route performs navigate()/redirect imperatively during the render path (only in effects or router lifecycle hooks).
Visiting /login while already authenticated redirects without triggering React warnings/errors about updates during render.
Visiting /admin as a non-admin shows the Access Denied screen without errors.

requirements.text: Verify backend authorization/bootstrap-admin logic builds and behaves correctly in a clean deployment so that admin gating does not cause traps/errors during app initialization (e.g., role/profile queries).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend query/mutation methods used by the app at startup (role/profile/products) do not trap for valid authenticated users due to missing permissions initialization.
Saving a caller user profile with email matching the configured bootstrap admin email (case-insensitive, trimmed) assigns Admin role without errors.
Admin-only methods remain protected and return a clear trap message when called by non-admins.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an upgrade requires state migration.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and any files under frontend/src/components/ui; compose/wrap instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new product features or redesign UI as part of this fix pass; focus on deployment/build stability only.
Do not add external services (databases, third-party auth providers, websockets, email/SMS providers) as part of this rebuild request.
